value.rationale: A natural chain evolution algebra has maximal nilindex, so classifying an entire operator space uniformly in dimension and in all characteristic-two fields is a motivated structural objective. The theorem proves an exact Frobenius-periodic parametrization and an exact finite-field rank census, not a chosen tiny example or elementary substitution in an applicable known theorem. The characteristic-two cancellation transforms the functional structure and exposes an abrupt boundary of the characteristic-zero theory. The rank distribution (every intermediate rank occurs exactly \(q(q-1)\) times) is a substantive natural invariant.
